richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Itanagar

c: Building an outdoor gym in Itanagar usually starts with a slope. Most sites in the capital of Arunachal Pradesh, whether a government complex, a school or a colony, sit on hillsides with limited flat ground. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to these sites, made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 2,280 km away and sent by road to the north-east.

Heavy rain falls for months in this part of the eastern Himalaya, and hill roads can be slow during the monsoon. We suggest planning delivery and installation for the drier months. Our installation team or a dealer in the north-east fixes each machine on a level grouted base. Send us photos of the site from two or three angles and a rough size of the flat area. We will fit the stations into it on a layout drawing.

items.q: Can outdoor gym equipment be installed on sloping ground?
items.a: Each machine needs a level base. On a slope we use flat terraces or level the base area and grout it. Our layout drawing shows where each machine can stand.

items.q: When is the best time to install in Itanagar?
items.a: The drier months, outside the monsoon, are best for hill delivery and grouting. Plan the order early so it can be dispatched in time.

items.q: Do you deliver to Arunachal Pradesh?
items.a: Yes. We send equipment by road from our factory in Vasai and install through our own team or a dealer in the north-east.
